audit.whatIsWrong: Leona is misgendered 'His/his/him' across tldr, dontsFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[9].t, and report[11].t.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists leona as she/her; the owner is addressed as 'you' so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy.
Favoured lane for Lux (4/10 diff) correctly reflects her range vs Leona's telegraphed dash-engage — chart already all-Lux and agrees with content win[].
Level 6 and first-item spikes correctly track R punishing her all-in and rooted mistimed engages.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: Shield of Daybreak (Q) resets her next auto for a stun — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the swing itself.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Standing in Eclipse (W) range while it's up — the shield absorbs your burst window, so force it out before you commit.

edits.after: Commit on Zenith Blade’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: Q the poke instead of the chain. Stand engage-range chipping. Trade his flash window. The R settles fights — it doesn’t open negotiations.
edits.after: Q the poke instead of the chain. Stand engage-range chipping. Trade her flash window. The R settles fights — it doesn’t open negotiations.

edits.before: - Leona Zenith Blade: matchup-defining — The blade root starts every Leona chain — stand behind minions while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Prismatic Barrier banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Zenith Blade (E): 12s at rank 1, down to 6s maxed — the root starts every chain, stand behind minions while it's up. - Shield of Daybreak (Q) auto-reset: 5s flat cooldown. - Keep W Prismatic Barrier banked for their best play.
